action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Andrew Bartlett discovered that AWL did not properly generate session
keys. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to guess a session
key and impersonate another user's session. (CVE-2020-11728)

It was discovered that AWL did not securely generate long-term session
cookies. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to guess a
session cookie through a brute-force attack and gain access to another
user's session. (CVE-2020-11729)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in AWL.
title: AWL vulnerabilities
